pr_title: c8d/images: handle images without manifests for default platform
pr_body: **- What I did** Fix https://github.com/moby/moby/issues/44578 **- How I did it** For clarity: what was previously not working was the following block: https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/b1569b9c185b9d5371d30fb59c14f4694239a4f3/daemon/containerd/image.go#L41-L50 passing ```go platform := platforms.AllPlatformsWithPreference(cplatforms.Default()) ``` into ```go containerdimages.Config(ctx, cs, desc, platform) ``` breaks because, after listing all the manifests in the index for the passed-in descriptor in: https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/b1569b9c185b9d5371d30fb59c14f4694239a4f3/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/images/image.go#L215 they get sorted according to the `platform := platforms.AllPlatformsWithPreference(cplatforms.Default())` in: https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/b1569b9c185b9d5371d30fb59c14f4694239a4f3/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/images/image.go#L221-L229 and then, in order of sorting, this block gets called: https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/b1569b9c185b9d5371d30fb59c14f4694239a4f3/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/images/image.go#L150-L156 Which breaks since we don't have the manifests for the other platforms and the platform we do have isn't the first on the list. **- How to verify it** - `docker pull --platform=[non-default-platform] alpine` - `docker inspect alpine` - `docker history alpine` **- Description for the changelog** **- A picture of a cute animal (not mandatory but encouraged)**
pr_comments: Will we want to cherry-pick this into 24? @neersighted @thaJeztah
I think so; we're not 100% sure when 25 will drop, so I think it will be good to get this out in the 24 patch release we intend to do this week.

issue_context.title: containerd-integration: cannot interact with images that don't have the default platform
issue_context.body:
### Description

Commands, such as `docker image inspect` and `docker image rm` default to use the default platform. If the default platform is not present for an image, the command fails.

### Reproduce

Make sure no image is present:

```bash
docker image rm busybox:latest
```

Pull the image for a platform that's not the default:

```bash
docker image pull --platform=linux/s390x busybox:latest
59f225fdf34f: Download complete
8e8f614949c5: Download complete
8460717a482e: Download complete
53b6cfce1626: Download complete
docker.io/library/busybox:latest
```

Verify that the image is present:

```bash
docker image ls
REPOSITORY       TAG          IMAGE ID       CREATED              SIZE
busybox          latest       59f225fdf34f   About a minute ago   2.01MB
```

Try to remove or inspect the image:

```bash
docker image rm busybox:latest
Error: No such image: busybox:latest

docker image rm 59f225fdf34f
Error: No such image: busybox:latest

docker image inspect busybox:latest
[]
Error: No such image: busybox:latest
```

### Workaround: to remove or inspect the image, pull the default platform:

```bash
docker image pull busybox:latest
59f225fdf34f: Exists
e68659cdc5b2: Download complete
73a648b1404c: Download complete
3e32979327a9: Download complete
docker.io/library/busybox:latest
```

```bash
docker image rm busybox:latest
Untagged: docker.io/library/busybox:latest
```


### Expected behavior

Interacting with the image to work

A "quick fix" would be to pick the first available architecture if the default is not available, but we need to look at a better UX (I'm writing up some ideas for that).
